data.content:
I sent one dispute, DD-51152 for $28.40. The owner chose to skip the three other drafts, and DD-51102 is held until you get me the order ticket. The next deadline is **2026-11-24**, 10 days away.

**Sent (with owner approval)**
- **DD-51152, $28.40, 90% win probability, strong.** The ticket lists only Veg Momo (Steamed) and Samosa Chaat, not the claimed Chicken Thukpa. The order was ready at 20:26 and picked up at 20:29. The dispute also says that neither fact shows what was in the bag.
- Recall history covers tickets that list the claimed item, which isn't this pattern, so I didn't rely on it.

**Drafted but skipped by the owner (not retried)**
- **DD-51131, $19.00, 77%, moderate.** This is a wrong-item claim, and there is no past history for that type. The draft leaves out the repeat-claimant count so it doesn't characterise the customer.
- **DD-51115, $17.50, 80%, moderate.** It matched a lesson in memory, `doordash:missing_item [pickup_handoff+1|ticket_lists_item+1]`: "Ticket listing the item plus a prompt handoff time won." Two of the three similar past cases won. The one loss involved a side item not itemised on the ticket, and Jhol Momo is on this ticket.
- **DD-51123, $14.25, 90% computed, moderate.** The evidence is circumstantial: the ticket lists the item and the handoff was prompt. The draft leaves out the repeat-claimant count here too.

**Weak: needs something from you**
- **DD-51102, $46.80, 35%.** This is the largest deduction, but there is no order ticket on file, so I couldn't compare the claimed Chicken Momo Party Tray to the order. If you send a photo of the ticket for this order, I can re-run the evidence check. It could move up the queue.

**Not worked up**
- DD-51140 ($13.75, 60%) and DD-51160 ($9.50, 60%) fell outside the top-5 cap. I didn't gather evidence on them.
- I recommend skipping DD-51171 ($11.00, 15% win probability). I also recommend skipping DD-50980 ($0.00), whose deadline passed 11 days ago.

I saved the case notes to `/plan.md`.
